T: Bernie's throwing a party. He just doesn't know it.
D: Two junior employees pretend their dead boss is alive at his beach house for the weekend.
P: Serve the cocktails when the guests turn up at Bernie's beach house.
S: Poached prawns chilled on shredded iceberg in tall glasses with a Marie Rose sauce of mayo, tomato sauce, lemon and horseradish, avocado and lemon wedges. Bring a pot of salted water to the boil, add 600g peeled green prawns and poach 2 minutes until just pink, then plunge into iced water. Mix 150g mayo, 3 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tsp horseradish, a squeeze of lemon and a dash of Worcestershire. Shred half an iceberg into four glasses, add diced avocado, pile on the prawns and spoon over the sauce. Dust with paprika and serve with lemon wedges.
Chopped clams folded into cream cheese and sour cream, with potato chips
Chopped clams folded through cream cheese and sour cream with lemon, Worcestershire and chives, with potato chips.
Water chestnuts wrapped in bacon, glazed with soy, brown sugar and ginger
Water chestnuts wrapped in bacon, brushed with soy, brown sugar and ginger, baked at 200C for 20 minutes until sticky.
M: Clams, lobster tails, corn and potatoes steamed in white wine and garlic butter

Lobster tails, clams, corn and small potatoes steamed in a big pot with white wine, garlic and butter, tipped onto the table. Boil 600g new potatoes for 10 minutes in a big pot. Add 4 halved corn cobs, 250ml white wine, 3 garlic cloves and 80g butter, then 1kg clams and 4 lobster tails. Cover and steam 8 minutes. Tip it all onto the table.

Sirloin marinated in soy, garlic, ginger and pineapple juice, grilled medium-rare, with charred pineapple, coconut rice and a sticky teriyaki glaze. Mix 80ml soy, 80ml pineapple juice, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 crushed garlic cloves and grated ginger. Marinate 4 sirloin steaks for 2 hours. Cook 300g jasmine rice with 400ml coconut milk and 200ml water. Grill the steaks on very high heat 3 minutes a side and rest 5 minutes. Grill 4 pineapple rings until charred. Boil the leftover marinade for 3 minutes until sticky and spoon over the sliced steak.
W: Buttery sponge baked over caramelized pineapple rings and cherries, flipped out
Brown sugar and butter in the tin, pineapple rings and cherries on top, butter cake batter poured over, baked at 175C for 45 minutes, flipped.
K: Two rums, orange liqueur, orgeat and lime shaken and poured over crushed ice

30ml white rum, 30ml dark rum, 15ml orange liqueur, 15ml orgeat and 25ml lime, shaken with ice, mint on top. For each drink, shake 30ml white rum, 30ml dark rum, 15ml orange liqueur, 15ml orgeat and 25ml lime juice with ice. Strain over crushed ice and top with a mint sprig. Makes four.

s.note: Chopped clams folded into cream cheese and sour cream, with potato chips
s.how: Drain a tin of chopped clams, keeping a little juice. Fold into 200g cream cheese and 100g sour cream with lemon juice, a dash of Worcestershire and chives. Serve with a bag of potato chips.

s.note: Water chestnuts wrapped in bacon, glazed with soy, brown sugar and ginger
s.how: Drain a tin of water chestnuts and wrap each in half a rasher of bacon, about 8 rashers in total. Brush with 2 tbsp soy, 2 tbsp brown sugar and grated ginger. Bake at 200C for 20 minutes until sticky.

m.note: Clams, lobster tails, corn and potatoes steamed in white wine and garlic butter
m.how: Boil 600g new potatoes for 10 minutes in a big pot. Add 4 halved corn cobs, 250ml white wine, 3 garlic cloves and 80g butter, then 1kg clams and 4 lobster tails. Cover and steam 8 minutes. Tip it all onto the table.

w.note: Buttery sponge baked over caramelized pineapple rings and cherries, flipped out
w.how: Melt 60g butter with 80g brown sugar in a tin. Lay pineapple rings with a cherry in each. Beat 125g butter and 125g sugar, add 2 eggs and fold in 175g self-raising flour. Spread over and bake at 175C for 45 minutes. Flip out.

d.note: Two rums, orange liqueur, orgeat and lime shaken and poured over crushed ice
d.how: For each drink, shake 30ml white rum, 30ml dark rum, 15ml orange liqueur, 15ml orgeat and 25ml lime juice with ice. Strain over crushed ice and top with a mint sprig. Makes four.
